post.caption: Her jewelry was locked away fifty years. Frida Kahlo wore large ancient jade beads and strung her ancient necklaces herself. A jade bead necklace from her wardrobe is kept in her museum, and her 1933 self portrait shows ancient jade beads. She also wore heavy Mexican silver rings, and photos show rings on many fingers. Some of her earrings were shaped like little hands. After 1954, her wardrobe was locked away for about 50 years. In 2004, about 300 items came out of her closets, and her Casa Azul museum showed them in 2012.
